items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after imaging and specialist consults on dislocated left elbow; now week-to-week and aiming to return ASAP. Ruled out only for this weekend's game vs Seahawks.
items.why: Imaging evaluated, multiple specialists consulted; consensus week-to-week.
items.implication: Short-term absence only; stash and monitor return timeline. Marcus Mariota starts.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/role for WAS pass-catchers short-term if Daniels misses multiple.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) DNP for second straight day. McVay: not making great progress; unlikely for Week 3 vs DEN.
items.why: Hip injury, no progress in practice; McVay cautious, time needed to heal.
items.implication: Miss Week 3; treat as out. Monitor Friday report.
items.opportunity: Full WR1 target/route share for Davante Adams.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day. Expected to miss Week 3 vs IND; grade 1, not long-term but cautious.
items.why: Hamstring, no practice since injury; sources expect miss.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 30% route targets / 28% share last week sans Collins; strong Colts TE matchup.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight day. Originated Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated W1 after 5-150-1 half; may miss Brazil game vs DAL.
items.why: Hamstring aggravation, incomplete practices, travel to Brazil complicates.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman WR1 role; Mark Andrews more targets.

items.text: Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks (core/groin) placed on IR after surgery; out at least 6 weeks. Hubbard clear lead back.
items.opportunity: Chuba Hubbard full snaps/touches; AJ Dillon backup.

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games with Michael Penix: >20 PPR avg, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game. TNF spot to revive if Penix healthy.
items.implication: WR1/2 ceiling if Penix plays well TNF.

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Results in missed games: 5-35-3 vs JAX (2025), 8-195-2 vs NYG. Elite WR1 opportunity if Nacua out again.
items.why: Route and target share data sans Nacua; proven production spikes.
items.implication: Adams locked WR1 this week and while Nacua sidelined.
items.opportunity: 42% target rate, high volume routes, red-zone upside.

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz saw 30% route targets and team-high 28% target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards. Love for Week 3.
items.why: Elevated target share + favorable TE matchup.
items.opportunity: High route/target share continuation if Collins out.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL in Brazil: highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D + prop line.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization. PIT allows 5th-most RB rush yards.
Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee meniscus procedure pre-W1) expected to return Week 3 vs NO after limited practices; good chance to debut.
items.why: Progressed in practice post-procedure; Rapoport/Schefter optimistic.
items.opportunity: Immediate high target share as top Raider pass-catcher.

items.text: TNF: Has Marshawn Lloyd totally blown chance and ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Averaging 38% snaps/10.5 touches but fewer rushes than Johnson W2; red-zone ties Brooks.
items.why: Snap/touch trends + fumble concerns; competition rising.

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson fumble W2, TreVeyon Henderson led NE backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Outlook improved but Stevenson still ranked ahead W3; gap narrowed.
items.why: Snap/touch spike post-fumble; pass-pro trust still issue.
items.implication: Henderson handcuff/flex value rising; monitor split.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term.

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.
items.opportunity: High aDOT and air yards share.
